meta.description: Create safety-bounded draft structures and run local deterministic checks for clinical case, diagnostic, trial, safety, and aggregate research reports. Use only with synthetic, de-identified, or aggregate inputs and verified source-fact manifests; every output requires qualified review.

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of clinical report types: case reports (CARE), diagnostic reports (ACR/CAP), trial reports (CONSORT/SPIRIT), CSRs (ICH E3), safety reports (ICH E2A/E2B/E2D), aggregate summaries

reliability.note: Exceptional reliability: non-negotiable boundary, input gate with 7 conditions, mandatory DRAFT marking, source-fact manifest requirement, deterministic validation only

performance_context.note: Excellent organization with route-before-drafting table, 4-step workflow, comprehensive reporting guidance routing, dated primary-source ledger

agent_usability.note: Outstanding boundary documentation: Non-Negotiable Boundary section with 9 prohibited actions, input gate with 7 required conditions, route-before-drafting table with 11 artifact types

human_usability.note: Clear setup with Python 3.11+, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE flag usage, no dependencies, multiple validation scripts with clear purposes

security.note: Exceptional security: PHI exclusion, local-only execution, no network/credentials/LLM/API, source-fact manifest with SHA-256 hashes, no direct identifier duplication

maintainability.note: Excellent structure with version 2.0, license (MIT), comprehensive assets/scripts/references, routing table with primary sources; minor: version 2.0 changes not documented

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with fail-closed templates; clear provenance tracking; explicit no-external-skill-calling boundary; minor: template population process could be more automated within safety constraints

key_strengths: Exceptional safety architecture with Non-Negotiable Boundary (9 prohibited actions), Input Gate (7 conditions), and mandatory DRAFT marking on all outputs
Outstanding routing framework with 11 artifact types mapped to primary standards (CARE, ACR, CAP, CONSORT, SPIRIT, ICH E3/E2A/E2B/E2D) with important boundaries
Excellent provenance system using source-fact manifests with SHA-256 hashes, no direct identifier duplication, and required fact ID citation for every populated field
Strong security posture: local-only execution, no network/credentials/LLM/API/image services, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE flag, deterministic validation only
Comprehensive script suite for validation (CARE, CONSORT, SPIRIT, ICH E3, terminology, de-identification, provenance, consistency) using only Python standard library

recommendations.title: Add automated input gate validation
recommendations.problem: 7 input gate conditions listed but automated checking mechanism not provided
recommendations.root_cause: Policy framework strong but implementation tooling incomplete
recommendations.fix: Add script: scripts/validate_input_gate.py that checks all 7 conditions from a gate-checklist.json file and exits non-zero if any condition fails, preventing workflow progression

recommendations.title: Implement fact ID citation enforcement
recommendations.problem: Requirement that every populated field cite fact IDs stated but validation not shown
recommendations.root_cause: No-inference policy clear but technical enforcement unclear
recommendations.fix: Extend validation scripts to check that every non-null field in output JSON has a corresponding fact_id_citation field or array, reject output if any populated field lacks provenance

recommendations.title: Document version 2.0 changes
recommendations.problem: Version 2.0 noted but breaking changes or new features not documented
recommendations.fix: Add changelog documenting what changed from 1.x: new report types, updated routing table, input gate formalization, or script API changes

recommendations.title: Clarify safe alternative selection for boundary violations
recommendations.problem: Guidance says offer template, manifest, or check but not how to select
recommendations.root_cause: Multiple safe alternatives without decision tree
recommendations.fix: Add decision tree: If request has authorized source data → offer blank template; if request lacks source data → offer source-fact manifest template; if request is about validation → offer deterministic check script
